snippet.title: Parenting wisdom and discerning God's will
snippet.description:
In this special bonus episode of the Jubilee Church Podcast, Lead Pastor Bryan Mowrey joins host Jordan Dillon for a deep conversation on parenting, time, and wisdom. Together, they discuss how to leverage time during parenting, the difference between day-to-day time and life’s opportunities, practicals of raising children from baby to adulthood, and the categories of wisdom from Proverbs (wise, simple, fool, evil). The conversation closes with a powerful discussion on how to orient your life around the will of God.

Whether you’re a parent, mentor, or simply seeking wisdom for daily life, this episode is packed with practical insight and biblical perspective.
